title: jmap-websocket: let a server close a running Connection with a code (1008 on credential expiry)
description: From the h05q spec patch: the WSS drafts say a server SHOULD close with 1008 when credentials expire, but jmap_websocket::tungstenite::serve's run loop only ends on a client Close, the end of incoming, or a binary frame (1003). Add a close handle (e.g. a CloseHandle from Connection) that sends a Close frame with a given code and reason and ends run; test it in the e2e suite.
